blind.description: A low, conical mound composed of clustered, low-poly faceted rocks and stones. The crevices between the stones are filled with bright yellow veins (representing gold or sulfur ore) and patches of dull green moss or oxidation. The faceted rocky elements are fused together into a solid, cohesive heap without floating pieces or gaps. The underside rests flat against the ground without an external plinth.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular cluster of faceted brown and grey rocks interwoven with golden yellow veins and mossy green patches.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.5 to 2 feet tall (about one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
